record.bible_text: Moreover the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,
Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, set<WH07760><WTH8798> thy face<WH06440> against mount<WH02022> Seir<WH08165>, and prophesy<WH05012><WTH8734> against it,

And say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto it, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Behold, O mount<WH02022> Seir<WH08165>, I <FI>am<Fi> against thee, and I will stretch out<WH05186><WTH8804> mine hand<WH03027> against thee, and I will make<WH05414><WTH8804> thee most<WH04923> desolate<WH08077>. <RF>most...: Heb. desolation and desolation<Rf>
I will lay<WH07760><WTH8799> thy cities<WH05892> waste<WH02723>, and thou shalt be desolate<WH08077>, and thou shalt know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.

Because thou hast had a perpetual<WH05769> hatred<WH0342>, and hast shed<WH05064><WTH8686> <FI>the blood of<Fi> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> by the force<WH03027> of the sword<WH02719> in the time<WH06256> of their calamity<WH0343>, in the time<WH06256> <FI>that their<Fi> iniquity<WH05771> <FI>had<Fi> an end<WH07093>: <RF>perpetual...: or, hatred of old<Rf> <RF>shed...: Heb. poured out the children<Rf> <RF>force: Heb. hands<Rf>

Therefore, <FI>as<Fi> I live<WH02416>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>, I will prepare<WH06213><WTH8799> thee unto blood<WH01818>, and blood<WH01818> shall pursue<WH07291><WTH8799> thee: sith<WH0518> thou hast not hated<WH08130><WTH8804> blood<WH01818>, even blood<WH01818> shall pursue<WH07291><WTH8799> thee.

Thus will I make<WH05414><WTH8804> mount<WH02022> Seir<WH08165> most<WH08077> desolate<WH08077>, and cut off<WH03772><WTH8689> from it him that passeth out<WH05674><WTH8802> and him that returneth<WH07725><WTH8802>. <RF>most...: Heb. desolation and desolation<Rf>

And I will fill<WH04390><WTH8765> his mountains<WH02022> with his slain<WH02491> <FI>men<Fi> : in thy hills<WH01389>, and in thy valleys<WH01516>, and in all thy rivers<WH0650>, shall they fall<WH05307><WTH8799> that are slain<WH02491> with the sword<WH02719>.

I will make<WH05414><WTH8799> thee perpetual<WH05769> desolations<WH08077>, and thy cities<WH05892> shall not return<WH07725><WTH8799><WTH8675><WH03427><WTH8799>: and ye shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>

Because thou hast said<WH0559><WTH8800>, These two<WH08147> nations<WH01471> and these two<WH08147> countries<WH0776> shall be mine, and we will possess<WH03423><WTH8804> it; whereas the LORD<WH03068> was there: <RF>whereas...: or, though the LORD was there<Rf>

Therefore, <FI>as<Fi> I live<WH02416>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>, I will even do<WH06213><WTH8804> according to thine anger<WH0639>, and according to thine envy<WH07068> which thou hast used<WH06213><WTH8804> out of thy hatred<WH08135> against them; and I will make myself known<WH03045><WTH8738> among them, when I have judged<WH08199><WTH8799> thee.

And thou shalt know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>, <FI>and that<Fi> I have heard<WH08085><WTH8804> all thy blasphemies<WH05007> which thou hast spoken<WH0559><WTH8804> against the mountains<WH02022> of Israel<WH03478>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, They are laid desolate<WH08074><WTH8804><WTH8675><WH08077>, they are given<WH05414><WTH8738> us to consume<WH0402>. <RF>to consume: Heb. to devour<Rf>

Thus with your mouth<WH06310> ye have boasted<WH01431><WTH8686> against me, and have multiplied<WH06280><WTH8689> your words<WH01697> against me: I have heard<WH08085><WTH8804> <FI>them<Fi> . <RF>boasted: Heb. magnified<Rf>
Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; When the whole earth<WH0776> rejoiceth<WH08055><WTH8800>, I will make<WH06213><WTH8799> thee desolate<WH08077>.

As thou didst rejoice<WH08057> at the inheritance<WH05159> of the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>, because it was desolate<WH08074><WTH8804>, so will I do<WH06213><WTH8799> unto thee: thou shalt be desolate<WH08077>, O mount<WH02022> Seir<WH08165>, and all Idumea<WH0123>, <FI>even<Fi> all of it: and they shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>
